scan_scope: ALL condensed frames in EVERY selected condition are scanned. The event CSV is not limited to the last frame. Only the separate final-species plots summarize last frames.
important_frame_note: condensed_frame_index_0based is a ZERO-BASED index into the condensed XYZ outputs, which were written with stride 100. It is not the original trajectory frame index. estimated_original_frame_index_0based equals condensed_frame_index_0based * 100.

event_definitions.N_or_O_component_without_H: A connected molecular component containing at least one N or O and no H.
event_definitions.H_only_component: A connected molecular component made only of H atoms, including H, H2, H3, etc.

hydrogen_assignment: Each H is assigned to its nearest other H, O, or N using periodic minimum-image distance.
event_row_scope: One row per flagged connected component per condensed frame.
